topic: Throwing away spoiled groceries every week vs planning seven dinners (Elias vs Maribel)

scenes.narration: The average family throws out sixteen hundred dollars of food yearly. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym beside a trash can overflowing with groceries, comic burst banner reads SIXTEEN HUNDRED WASTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elias and Maribel both spend six hundred monthly on groceries.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man elias and woman maribel pushing identical carts tagged SIX HUNDRED A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both shop hungry on Sunday with no list at all.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two shoppers grabbing random items off shelves under a sign reading NO LIST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Elias buys whatever looks good and forgets the back shelf.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man elias opening a fridge stuffed with forgotten containers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every Friday he tosses slimy produce and expired dairy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man elias dumping wilted vegetables into a trash can stamped FRIDAY AGAIN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That is roughly a hundred forty dollars binned each month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a trash can sitting on a gym scale reading ONE FORTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Maribel plans seven dinners and shops that list only.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maribel holding a meal plan card reading SEVEN DINNERS beside a short shopping list, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She cooks the fastest spoiling food first, every single week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maribel cooking spinach and berries first beside a chart reading SPOILS FIRST COOK FIRST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leftovers become labeled lunches instead of forgotten science experiments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, neatly labeled lunch containers lined up in a tidy fridge stamped LUNCH READY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her grocery bill drops to four hundred seventy monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman maribel flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading FOUR SEVENTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same meals, same family, fifteen hundred dollars saved yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a gym locker stamped FIFTEEN HUNDRED SAVED with a full tidy fridge painted on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Plan seven dinners and shop the list. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading PLAN SEVEN DINNERS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
